combat.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the roster rows

worn.evidence: the traces of `sources`: each appearance block, by its worn objects

weaponPoison.evidence: the traces of `sources`: type 2 splats on a player in the tick of an attack or the 2 ticks after it
weaponPoison.note: the worn name says which dagger; the splat sizes say how strong the poison is

food.evidence: the traces of `sources`: animation 829 (human_eat), and the Hitpoints of the splats before and after it
food.note: a heal of 20 is a shark (consume_normal.dbrow)

foodCount.closes: the tick record of a bounded squad run (packages/core/src/tick-record.ts) against the name, to its retreat: the eats of one fight are its pack
foodCount.note: the most eats against one opponent: 6; the food did not run out

consumesNotForHitpoints.evidence: the traces of `sources`: animation 829 at 90 Hitpoints or more, or with no splat in the 20 ticks before
consumesNotForHitpoints.note: a drink and an eat play the same animation (anti_poison.rs2:3); which item it was is not known

potions.closes: a splat over 22 with no Protect from Melee (a Strength boost), or a drink that restores no Hitpoints, in a longer run of scripts/measure/pk-gang-collect.ts
potions.note: Herblore has no level on any of the three; a drink and an eat share animation 829

runes.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the names of all animations of the name
runes.note: the name attacks with melee only

animations.evidence: the traces of `sources`: each animation of the name, by its name in the content

ticksBetweenAttacksWithAnEat.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the same, with an eat between the two attacks

tilesToTarget.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the tiles of both at each attack

damage.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the first splat on the player in the tick of the attack or the 2 ticks after it (two splats for a special), when no second gang account attacked it then
damage.note: 214 splats with two gang accounts on the player are left out

specials.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the order of each fight (pk-rival-feed.ts digest)

specialAtTargetHp.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the Hitpoints of the player before the splats of the tick of the special

specialAtOwnHp.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the last Hitpoints of the name that a splat showed

protectOn.evidence: the traces of `sources`: each change of the head icon, with the weapon class and the last animation of the player in the fight

ticksFromWeaponChangeToPrayer.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the appearance block of the opponent, then that of the name

ticksAProtectPrayerStaysOn.evidence: the traces of `sources`: head icon on to head icon off or changed
ticksAProtectPrayerStaysOn.note: a flick would show as many holds of 1 or 2 ticks

splatsTaken.evidence: the traces of `sources`: splats on the name, by its protect prayer in that tick

prayerPoints.closes: the tick record of a bounded squad run (packages/core/src/tick-record.ts): no feed field holds prayer points; the tick at which the head icon goes off for good under attack is the sign

otherPrayers.closes: none: a prayer with no head icon (Protect Item, the Strength, Attack and Defence prayers) is in no public data; the damage ceiling is the only sign

chaosAltarVisits.evidence: the traces of `sources`: roster frames within 4 tiles of (2948, 3820)

monasteryVisits.evidence: the traces of `sources`: roster frames within 12 tiles of (3052, 3490)

hpAtEat.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the Hitpoints of the last splat in the 20 ticks before animation 829
hpAtEat.note: "not known": an eat within 60 ticks of an eat with no splat between

ticksFrom74HpOrLessToTheEat.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the first splat that left 74 or less, then the eat

eatsWithin3TicksOfAnEat.evidence: the traces of `sources`: two animations 829 at most 3 ticks apart

place.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the tile of each roster frame (each 10 ticks)

standsOffThePost.evidence: the traces of `sources`: roster frames on the tile of the frame before, off the post, no attack for 20 ticks

steps.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the step records of each tick

trips.evidence: the traces of `sources`: from the roster frame off the post to the next one on it

rankByDistanceFromPostOfTheFirstTarget.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the players the game lets the name attack at the frame of the leave, nearest to the post first

targetChange.evidence: the traces of `sources`: an attack on a new player within 40 ticks of the last one on the old player

targetTilesMovedBetweenTwoAttacks.evidence: the traces of `sources`: the tile of the player at two attacks at most 8 ticks apart
targetTilesMovedBetweenTwoAttacks.note: a player that moves is still attacked

frozen.evidence: the traces of `sources`: spot animations 179 to 181 (the impact of Entangle, Snare, Bind) on the name

at40HpOrLess.closes: the tick record of a bounded squad run (packages/core/src/tick-record.ts) that takes the name to 40 Hitpoints or less
at40HpOrLess.note: the range of the Hitpoints is the range in which the two samples of the other accounts ended; level 16 is the post and level 20 the last level of a teleport

prayedAgainst.evidence: the traces of `sources`: attack animations of players that face the name, by the weapon of the player
prayedAgainst.note: the rule that turns a protect prayer on is not known; this table is its evidence

hitBy.evidence: the traces of `sources`: attack animations of players that face the name

death.closes: a death of the name in a longer run of scripts/measure/pk-gang-collect.ts

skull.evidence: the traces of `sources`: head icon bit 1

schedule.evidence: the traces of `sources`: roster frames with the name, of all roster frames of that hour
